messages:
Sam F.: heads-up — spotted ~10 invoices that Stripe marked paid overnight but never landed in NetSuite. noticed after doing a daily revenue sanity check :eyes:
Jenna R.: ugh. any error logs from the netcharge job? which run window?
Sam F.: nightly `netcharge-sync` run at 00:30 UTC. logs show successful POST to our NS endpoint but NS returned 202 and then nothing was created. here's the chunk from the job: 
```
2026-03-22T00:30:31Z INFO posting invoice external_id=inv_20260322_87
2026-03-22T00:30:31Z DEBUG NS_RESPONSE status=202 body="accepted"
2026-03-22T00:30:31Z INFO marked as posted external_id=inv_20260322_87
```
But NetSuite doesn't have the invoice and later reconcile shows missing journal.
Alex C.: can you grep the netcharge DLQ? maybe the NS async job failed to complete and we never retried. also check if we sent idempotency headers — duplicates or race?
Sam F.: good call. looked into the DLQ; there are entries for the invoice payloads but the DLQ consumer shows this repeated error: `NS: record already exists` at the final step, then consumer drops it. weird because NS doesn't have the record.
Maria O.: that `record already exists` from NS typically means an internal conflict where the external_id index thinks it exists but the record rollback happened earlier. we had a similar pattern during last year's DST deploy where two sync windows overlapped and created partial writes.
Jenna R.: overlapping windows? our cron changed when we moved to k8s cronjobs. are we double-scheduling around DST or UTC conversions?
Alex C.: looking at the job config: `cron: 30 0 * * *` but the k8s cluster has NODE_TIMEZONE=America/Los_Angeles set for legacy reasons. the controller converts to local and then the orchestrator also applies UTC, so during the DST boundary the job executed twice yesterday. that would explain partial writes + conflicting retries.
Sam F.: confirmed: CloudWatch/k8s event shows two triggers at `2026-03-22T00:30:31Z` and `2026-03-22T01:30:01Z` — payloads identical. first run got 202 then second run attempted to upsert and NS returned `already exists` even though the first run didn't finish its async commit. DLQ consumer then assumed final state inconsistent.
Jenna R.: what's the minimal fix to stop ongoing corruption? can we make the posting idempotent server-side or add idempotency keys client-side?
Alex C.: quick mitigation: enhance the DLQ consumer to retry with exponential backoff and if NS returns `already exists` then call `GET /records?external_id=...` to check real state before dropping. longer term: add an `Idempotency-Key` header built from `invoice.external_id` + `job_run_id` so NS upsert is truly idempotent.
Maria O.: for the short-term we should also pause the nightly cron until we patch. can someone open a short outage ticket? ops page might need an alert so that finance knows recon will be delayed.
Sam F.: I'll pause the cron now (doing it). also starting a quick reconciliation script to reprocess DLQ items safely.
StripeBot: automated alert: 10 payments processed (2026-03-22) with metadata.external_id present. Link: https://dashboard.stripe.com/payments?query=metadata.external_id
Jenna R.: assigning: Alex to DLQ consumer fix + idempotency header change (PR target: staging today). Sam to run reconciliation script and open ticket to pause cron (done). Maria to coordinate with NetSuite SME if we need a manual repair. I'll review the PR and approve deploy.
Alex C.: will open PR 4273 — adds `Idempotency-Key: invoice:{external_id}` and a `GET` verification fallback. testing on staging now.
Sam F.: reconciliation script re-queued 10 invoices to safe-reprocess topic with dedupe check. will report when all reconcile ops finish.
Maria O.: quick note — if we need to do manual NS deletes/repairs, tag support@ns-admins.avoid mass deletes; prefer re-run after we've verified idempotency.
Jenna R.: thanks team. once PR is merged we can unpause cron and monitor for 24h. :thumbsup: any objections to hotfix to prod after staging tests pass?
Alex C.: no objections. will create rollout plan + canary (10% of runs) then full.
Sam F.: update: reconciliation finished, 9/10 invoices reprocessed successfully, 1 flagged for manual review (external_id=inv_20260322_91).
Jenna R.: marking this thread resolved pending PR merge. follow-up: postmortem if any manual NS repair is required. :raised_hands:
